description: The company's latest filed accounts read into plain figures, this year and last. From Companies House's tagged (iXBRL) accounts document - net assets, current assets, cash, debtors, creditors due within and after a year, equity, turnover and profit where the accounts include them, average employees, for the current and prior period; audit status, standards, dormant flag; what the accounts leave out. Accounts filed as a PDF can't be read and the call's credits go back. 2 credits. Use this for the figures themselves; for whether accounts are due or overdue use deadlines, for the company's health distress_signals.

company.description: A UK company number (8 characters, such as 00502851 or SC123456) is surest; a name also works and goes to the closest registered company, which the reply names. Use company_search first when a name could mean several companies.

title: Filed Accounts
